name: Apaq Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Apaq Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of electronic components in Taiwan, Asia, and internationally. It offers conductive polymer aluminum electrolytic and solid capacitors; conductive polymer hybrid aluminum electrolytic capacitors; chip-type capacitors; wafer capacitors; and organic semiconductor solid-state capacitors. Apaq Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Miaoli, Taiwan.
